reviewContext.userProblem: Round 1 of the audit of the 3D CAD pages and the AI capture feature on feat/ai-capture (0a35708..eb7d8c9) returned needs_fix=true with 16 major findings (5 high, 11 medium): open-mesh multi-target cuts, PCB reference page kind, CAD UI strict-index compilation, point limit after allocation, interference boundary fold, sketch base-plane control, full body ID selection, sketch profile pair scans, native mesh bounds, desktop capture byte arrays, overlay sample allocation, STL inline refusal, interference sparse pairs, Add targets, capture report contract and capture body classification.
requiredOutcomes: F1 function-open-mesh-multitarget-cut: a Boolean feature with any display-only open mesh target fails atomically (cad.body.missing), attaches no step, fails dependants; mesh stays visible; worker and capture agree; block scene bytes equal the cut-suppressed capture (plans a1, a2, b2).

F2 function-pcb-reference-page-kind: CLI, MCP and desktop capture report cad.reference.missing like cad check when a board page is no longer PCB; picker omits it; insertion rejects it (Q1-gated d2); undo restores (plans d, d2).
F3 function-hosted-cad-strict-compilation: zero noUncheckedIndexedAccess diagnostics rooted at packages/ui-solid/src/cad-ui.tsx, enforced by strict-index.test.ts (plan j).
F4 performance-capture-point-limit-after-allocation: point limit charged before allocation, zero tools visited past the threshold, precedence and admitted bytes unchanged (plans a1, b1, b3).

F5 performance-interference-boundary-fold: accumulated boundary reads charged against a deterministic allowance with incomplete-analysis reporting; admitted reports and bytes identical across thread counts (plan g).
F6 function-sketch-base-plane-control: undoable XY/YZ/ZX selector keeping the offset and respecting lock/read-only (plan k).
F7 function-interference-full-body-id: exact ID first, indexed lookup, dedup, stable order, ambiguity still fails, lazy error list (plan c).
F8 performance-sketch-profile-pair-scans: 2D bounds-narrowed segment and containment candidates, non-quadratic counts in both layouts (plan l).
F9 performance-native-mesh-bounds: native wireframe export uses Rust bounds without the TS decoder; native shaded capture uses decode-pass bounds; bytes unchanged (plans a1, a2; Q2-gated).
F10 performance-desktop-capture-byte-arrays: binary request body and binary framed reply; image and report equal the direct render (plan f).
F11 performance-overlay-sample-allocation: no per-sample candidate vector, skip pairs with fewer than two hits, pixels unchanged (plan h).
F12 performance-stl-inline-refusal: refuse before sort/encode on a conservative surviving-triangle bound; degenerate-heavy input still imports; packages/io does not import @nodetto/core (plan m).
F13 performance-interference-sparse-pairs: sweep-based candidate discovery with sub-quadratic comparisons and output equal to exhaustive enumeration (plan i).
F14 maintainability-cad-add-targets: Add never commits more than one target; undo restores the original Cut (plan k).
F15 maintainability-capture-report-contract: shared report validation; desktop rejects mismatches before picker/write (plan e).
F16 maintainability-capture-body-classification: first-tool classification computed once per render and shared by picture and candidates (plan i).
Repository lint, typecheck and existing tests pass; final integration runs CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify, bun run typecheck and bun run lint.
nonGoals: The two low findings function-force-identical-rewrite and performance-identical-capture-file-copy.
Editing files outside each plan's writePaths, tsconfig*.json, impl-plans/README.md, lockfiles or indexes; archiving plans; workspace-wide formatting.
Regenerating goldens or changing error codes/messages except where a finding requires it.
Reclassifying tools in lattice::sample_body_axis (census path; census.rs out of scope).
Any server, auth, secret or deployment content; pushing or rewriting history.
constraints: Work only in /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/nodetto-app-capture on feat/ai-capture; never push, never rewrite history, never touch other worktrees.
AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and a plan-local CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/car1-<plan>; cargo fmt on touched Rust.
Indexed reads must type-check under noUncheckedIndexedAccess; packages/io must not import @nodetto/core; packages/core/src/pcb imports only itself.
Heavy per-pixel, per-vertex and per-byte work stays in Rust (native CLI runs TS core in Boa).
Captures stay deterministic; existing goldens and digests unchanged.
Every fix ships a test failing on eb7d8c9 and passing after; performance findings assert deterministic counts, never wall-clock.
Never relax or delete tests; timing tests may be retried up to three times, then compared in isolation.

Gated plans read design-docs/user-qa/ai-capture-audit-r1.md first: car1-d2-pcb-insert-guard needs Q1 'Decision: approved', car1-a2-native-wiring needs Q2 'Decision: approved'; otherwise they make no edit and record 'blocked: Qn pending'; b2 and b3 stay blocked through a2.
Each plan writes only its writePaths and its own progress log impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md with pre/post sha256, commands, exit codes and log paths under target/car1-<plan>/logs/.
Native parity requires building the release nodetto-cli first and setting NODETTO_CLI_TEST_BINARY.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: One plan per finding or per same-module finding group, 17 plans in four waves (a1,b1,c,d,f,g,h,j,k,l,m | e,i,d2,a2 | b2 | b3).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Maximum concurrency with disjoint writes per wave; dependencies only where plans share files (scene.ts, construction.ts, cad-request.ts, export-handlers.ts, crates/capture interference/lattice/raster) or a contract (a1 decoder overloads, j strict-index test).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Mesh decoder capture contract (vertexCount, bounds, booleanTarget, optional geometry, streaming over-limit path) defined once in Rust and TS by a1 with exactly two TS overloads; a2 types it in core and the native CLI.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Shared seam for F1 eligibility, F4 pre-allocation limit and F9 Rust bounds; the one-argument overload keeps existing callers (capture-cad.ts:123, export-handlers.ts:273, cad-command.ts:56) compiling unedited without casts.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Scope amendments Q1 (board-picker.tsx guard) and Q2 (commands.ts, svg-export theme.ts and document.ts) are gated in design-docs/user-qa/ai-capture-audit-r1.md.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: These files are outside the audit's listed files; plans self-block while the decision reads pending, so ungated plans proceed independently.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: F1 implemented as a display-only mesh visitor result in construction.ts so the existing absent-target rule fails the whole feature.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Matches editor semantics without renderer or Rust changes and keeps dependency failure propagation (cad.reference.failed).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: F5 charges |accumulated boundaries| per combine against 64 * w * (rays + 16) per request.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Deterministic per-request cast order, no shared atomics, admitted cases unchanged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: F10 uses a raw Tauri request body with format/quality headers and a u32-LE-framed binary reply.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Same framing as the native CLI packet; export-handlers.ts captureSolid signature unchanged.

intentionalTradeoffs: Census path (lattice::sample_body_axis) keeps its own is_solid filter; F16 shared classification covers picture and candidates only (residual).
a1 is 181 lines, above the ~150-line guideline, because it carries the requested overload contract.
If Q1/Q2 stay pending, F2 commit-time guard, F9, F1 and F4 remain open and plans d2, a2, b2, b3 report blocked.
If TS overload resolution fails at cad-command.ts:56, a2 stops with a scope-amendment request rather than adding casts.
supportedEdgeCases: Open, mixed-winding, double-sided, coplanar and translated flat-shell meshes as rejected targets; closed tetrahedra, thin bar and translated thin bar as valid targets.
Body queries: full ID that is also a prefix or another body's name, duplicates, truly ambiguous prefixes.
More than eight depth-tied bodies in the overlay; single screen-filling body.
Horizontal and vertical disjoint contour rows; crossing segments reporting the same first segment.
Degenerate-dominated high-facet STL inputs still import.
Point limit exactly at 4,000,000 admitted; overflow with sentinel prisms and meshes; hidden-only overflow; body-query and header-error precedence.
Report mismatches in width, height or body count individually; cancellation with a matching report.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Pre-existing EPERM roundtrip-log failure in packages/cad-kernel/src/worker-host.test.ts (compared in isolation).
Transient sibling failures in shared-tree typecheck, strict-index probe or crate builds (rerun after the sibling is done and record both runs).
